decision: FastAPI modular monolith with a built React frontend
why: Streaming AI and a single portable application process; React provides admin and workspace interfaces.
alternative: Django plus a separate frontend server
consequence: Authentication, administration and background lifecycle must be implemented explicitly.

decision: PostgreSQL with pgvector and exact tenant-filtered cosine search
why: User explicitly requested pgvector; demo scale does not justify approximate indexing.
alternative: NumPy search over array columns, or HNSW immediately
consequence: Host must install the vector extension; model dimensions and identity are validated.

decision: Durable database jobs, one I/O thread, one AI thread and APScheduler
why: Avoid Redis/Celery and a second terminal while preserving restartable work.
consequence: Run one Uvicorn process; horizontal scaling requires a later lifecycle design.

decision: Ollama generation and embedding adapters are separate
why: Local demo now, generation-provider migration later without changing business APIs.
alternative: Call a provider directly from each feature
consequence: Changing embeddings requires explicit re-indexing; no fallback pretending to be a fresh model result.

decision: Japanese OCR deferred; image upload and preview remain available
why: Explicit user clarification overrides the all-Must brief for scanned documents.
consequence: US-E05, F01 and K04 cannot be claimed fully complete for image/scanned text interpretation.

decision: Default mail goes to an authenticated, scoped in-app outbox
why: Offline demo without SMTP or external sending.
consequence: Local demo only; outbox messages contain sensitive invitation/reset links.

decision: Closed resource kinds share a versioned JSONB record table; identity, vectors, jobs and usage use dedicated tables
why: Common history, ownership and review mechanics reduce duplication across the SRS.
alternative: A distinct SQL table for every content entity
consequence: Service validation and scoped access tests are essential; JSON relations need explicit checks.

decision: Keep reported scope separate from verified acceptance
why: The 98-story ledger must not label planned or partial work as complete.
consequence: Reports retain failures, blocked tests, production gaps and external content approvals.

decision: Use qwen2.5:3b as the tested generation default; keep Qwen3 configurable
why: Ollama 0.40.3 with qwen3:4b emitted reasoning rather than the requested final greeting, including with think=false and /no_think. The comparison model returned a correct short Japanese greeting.
alternative: Upgrade the user’s Ollama installation or keep an unreliable Qwen3 demo default
consequence: One additional downloaded model; model name remains configurable. Qwen3 is not removed from the user’s machine.

decision: Use confirmed evidence for documents and block known unverified high-risk claims before publishing
why: A real-model draft asserted a proposed certification. The regression exposed both context eligibility and a missing marker after Markdown headings.
alternative: Rely only on instructions and a footer disclaimer
consequence: Documents exclude proposed facts, uncited prose gets paragraph markers, known unverified certification/revenue values are rejected, and one real-model correction is attempted before failing safely. Semantic factual evaluation remains incomplete.
